name: Example B2B SaaS Marketing Recruitment | Specialists in SaaS - Product, Demand & Growth Hiring
tagline: Specialists in B2B SaaS Marketing Recruitment
description:

Companies come to us for crucial marketing & sales hires where traditional processes have failed, delivering too many unqualified candidates. We fix that, and we fix it at speed, removing those hiring bottlenecks, and unlocking access to high-pedigree talent.

You can work with Example in multiple ways:

- One-off (contingent) hiring
- Project-based hiring for multiple hires
- Embedded talent for scale-ups
- As an advisor, e.g. to boost talent attraction

The result is a search system that compounds: better-fit traffic, faster sales cycles, and budget conversations that become a lot easier.

Our founder brings 15+ years of leadership experience from Accenture, Salesforce, Dell, and CA Technologies. He's seen how easily organizations spend millions without moving the needle. Today, we help B2B executives cut through the noise, connect the dots between strategy and execution, and build systems that scale cleanly and profitably.
Who We Serve

We work with leaders who are on the hook for results:

CIOs managing complex tech stacks and proving ROI
CROs aligning revenue operations with growth targets
RevOps Leaders optimizing systems and eliminating friction

If your transformation is stalled, your team is overwhelmed, or your board is asking hard questions, you don't need another PowerPoint. You need a partner who can deliver.

Our Approach

We don't just advise—we implement. Whether you're deploying new technology, optimizing existing systems, or navigating AI and automation initiatives, we bring strategic clarity and tactical execution. We help you lead your team through transformation with confidence.

tagline: Revenue system methodology for B2B founders and operators.
description:
B2B Growth Systems is a methodology company. 

We develop and publish revenue system doctrine for B2B founders and operators.

The methodology emerges from 18 years of practice across 30+ companies from pre-revenue startups to enterprises generating eight figures annually. 

Our founder, James Carby-Robinson, began with 100-200 cold calls per day, built outbound engines for software companies, product resellers, and consultancies, and learned through direct experience what works, what doesn't, and why. That experience became doctrine.

What We Publish
B2B Growth Systems maintains a body of work covering the five phases every B2B company must navigate:

Growth Strategy — Market positioning and competitive architecture
Product-Market Fit — Validation before scale
Lead Generation — Systematic pipeline creation
Demand Generation — Building market gravity
Scaling with Paid Media — Amplification of proven systems

Each phase is documented with principles, frameworks, and case studies—including instructive failures that reveal what happens when methodology is ignored.

What We Believe
Revenue is not random. It is the output of systems designed to produce it.
Most B2B companies fail not from lack of effort but from building phases out of sequence, optimizing tactics before strategy, or generating leads into systems that cannot convert them. The methodology exists to prevent these failures.

Case Studies
Our work is documented through real engagements: Ecoloxtech, HK Defense Solutions, SoftwareX, Plexian, WonderBiz, and Keyura. Success cases demonstrate what the methodology produces. Instructive cases demonstrate what happens when conditions for success don't exist.

We publish both because a methodology that only reports wins is incomplete.

FlameFunnels
For companies that want implementation rather than methodology, FlameFunnels is our done-for-you revenue system practice. Same principles. Installed for you.

name: The Go To Market Handbook For B2B SaaS Leaders
tagline: A practical guide for founders and revenue leaders who want to scale their business with clarity and confidence.
description:
This book has been written for people we regard as heroes.
There are few people we admire more than the Founders and Leaders of software companies who have the courage, determination and, some might say, sheer madness to put their livelihoods and reputation on the line, to leave their own ‘dent in the universe’. It's a day to day, up at dawn, pride swallowing siege to lead such a business. And we know this for a fact because we’ve walked in your shoes many times. 
Over the last 25 years, we’ve been involved in the start-up, scale up and exit of several successful technology businesses, that between them have realised close to billion dollars of shareholder value. But along the way we've also had more than our fair share of disappointments and have the mental scars and bruising to prove it. We’ve made mistakes and fallen in what felt like bottomless pits. But fascinatingly enough, we learned as much from the ones that didn’t work, as we did from the successes. It’s these lessons which we thought we'd share in this book.
So why have we embarked on this journey? Well having sat in your chair many times, we can tell you that being the leader of a B2B SaaS business can be a lonely place. The army call it the loneliness of leadership and take great steps to ensure their officers are constantly communicated with, encouraged, and sustained. 
But in the world of technology, there’s little help available. Unlike our greatest sportsmen, many of our leading SaaS Founders don’t have an experienced support team around them, looking after every aspect of their well-being. They have to carry the load alone. The three of us were lucky as we’ve always had each other, and I can’t tell you the number of times we’ve talked each other of various high ledges!
For many though, the challenge is who to turn to when things aren’t going to plan.

• Financial Services & Insurance

For a lot of B2B companies, the website is treated like a brochure.

It gets redesigned every few years. Looks nicer. Wins a few compliments internally. But nothing really changes.

Traffic keeps coming in. Leads… don’t.

And the marketing team is left wondering why their biggest digital asset isn’t actually helping them grow. We see this all the time.

Marketing leaders come to us after trying everything else:

- More ad spend
- More SEO content
- More landing pages
- More campaigns

But the results don’t match the effort.

Because the problem usually isn’t traffic. It’s the website.

When your site can’t clearly communicate:
- What you offer
- Why it matters
- Why you’re better than alternatives
- Why someone should trust you

Visitors leave. Opportunities disappear. And the pressure lands squarely on marketing to explain why growth is slowing down.

That’s why we take a different approach.

Instead of treating websites like design projects, we treat them like growth assets.

We focus on:
→ Messaging that clearly communicates your value
→ Design that guides visitors toward the right actions
→ Development that supports marketing long after launch

In other words, we build websites that actually do their job.

Over the past 15 years we’ve helped hundreds of companies turn their websites into assets that:
- Generate higher-quality leads
- Communicate their value more clearly
- Stand out in competitive markets
- Support marketing and sales instead of slowing them down

Because a website shouldn’t just exist. It should help you grow.

If your website isn’t doing that today, there are two ways to start fixing it:

name: Basepair Inc
tagline: Combining easy NGS analysis & visualization for bench scientists w/ efficient scaling & deployment for bioinformaticians
description:
Basepair is a next generation bioinformatics company. Through a combination of intuitive interfaces and modern architecture we are reimagining what a commercial platform can deliver to R&D organizations. We're on a mission to make genomic data analysis & visualization more accessible to a broader range of scientists so that the promise of precision medicine can become a reality.

One of the biggest challenges preventing this now arguably lies not with how the data gets generated and processed, but who is able to perform the analysis and understand what the resulting data means. Limiting this work to a select few, whether through choice or more often because of technology restrictions, especially for routine analyses, leads to reduced efficiency in R&D teams, longer times to market for assay manufacturers and increased turnaround times in clinical settings. Unlike other more traditional alternatives, our philosophy is not to ask bioinformaticians to change the way they work by having to build workflows on our platform. Instead, once they are built and ready for sharing or production settings, Basepair can significantly improve and accelerate both scaling & deployment to colleagues, collaborators and customers wherever they happen to be in the world.

To do this in a way that is adapted to the dynamics of the market today, we believe a bioinformatics platform needs to:

1) Leverage the compute and storage resources in a third party cloud account without the requirement of installing inside an organization's vpc
2) Facilitate the bundling of analysis with the sale of a kit or assay through easy white labeling and tokens/coupons
3) Support ever increasing sample volumes and application areas through an extensible architecture that scales to millions of records, enables complete sample provenance and reduces cloud costs

Introducing Basepair…bioinformatics reinvented.

name: Uncork Capital
tagline: Uncork is a seed-stage venture firm investing in founder potential long before it's obvious.
description:
For more than 20 years, Uncork has focused on one stage: seed. Our partners have invested in over 290 companies, with more than 100 meaningful outcomes and $60B+ in enterprise value created — including Fitbit (NYSE: FIT, Google), Sendgrid (NYSE: SEND, Twilio), Eventbrite (NYSE: EB), Poshmark (NASD: POSH), and Postmates (UBER), as well as fast-growing startups like [Loft Orbital](https://loftorbital.com/), [LaunchDarkly,](https://launchdarkly.com/) [Human Interest](https://humaninterest.com/), [Gamma](https://gamma.app/), [GPTZero](https://gptzero.me/), [Tailscale](https://tailscale.com/), [Numeral](https://www.numeral.io/), [Ivo](https://www.ivo.ai/), [Coder](https://coder.com/), [Anything](https://www.anything.com/), [Hallow](https://hallow.com/), [ClassDojo](https://www.classdojo.com/), [Wrapbook](https://www.wrapbook.com/), and [Carrot Fertility](https://www.get-carrot.com/).

We invest in companies using AI and emerging technologies to create leverage, unlock scale, and push industries forward. We're typically the first major check on the cap table, often leading seed rounds with an initial investment of $3M-$5M. We keep terms simple and transparent, because a clean term sheet makes a strong partnership.

We look for team, TAM, and tailwinds, but conviction in founder–market fit comes above all else. We back founders who bring sharp insight into their markets and the drive to build what others can’t yet see.

There’s no single playbook for building a company. Every journey looks different, but our role stays the same: a steady partner who shows up early, knows when to deliver hard truths, and stays engaged long after the round closes.

Learn more at [uncorkcapital.com].

- Time Management

Our flagship product, Kronoscope uses AI to accurately predict future inventory imbalances which lead to out of stock situations or wastage, and also recommends best ways of minimizing their impact.

Kronoscope is powered by state of the art demand sensing and pricing engine which takes into account several factors like historical sales trends, seasonality, holidays, markdown events and pricing changes to predict future inventory requirements and optimize prices. Predicted inventory demand is also aligned with supply side data to identify ideal suppliers and replenishment quantities that minimize chances of stock outs or inventory wastage.

There is no outsourcing, and the founder and senior leads stay reachable on every account.

Owners choose Elatre because the work is honest, fast, and measurable, and because one team handles both marketing and software.

Thus enabling success managers to deliver a superior customer onboarding experience, retain customers, drive, upsell and improve Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) and Life-time Value (LTV) for SaaS businesses.

CustomerSuccessBox was founded in 2016 by Puneet Kataria (Founder & CEO), who comes with over 16 years of marketing, sales and customer success experience and Amritpal Singh (Co-founder & CTO), who comes with over 5 years of new product development experience. Its patent pending technology has processed over 30 million data points from over 100,000 end users to calculate Account Health Scores. 

At CustomerSuccessBox, we recognize both the opportunities and the challenges that come along. Our vision is to enable every CSM to manage and grow a multi-million dollar portfolio with hundreds of customer accounts. And achieve all this in a predictable, process and data driven fashion.

Request a demo to see CustomerSuccessBox in action - https://customersuccessbox.com

name: Rubicon Venture Capital
description:
Rubicon Venture Capital is a bi-coastal VC (SF and NYC) that invests in Late Seed and Series A & B venture capital financing rounds of high potential early stage disruptive technology companies. We are focused on backing consumer and enterprise technology companies in the internet, software and connected verticals. This includes fintech, insurance tech, hospitality tech, marketing tech, big data, AI, machine leaning, enterprise Saas, B2B and B2C. 

We have co-invested in disruptive companies with notable VCs and angels such as Eric Schmidt, Peter Thiel, Google Ventures, Founders Fund, Sequoia Capital, Menlo Ventures, Battery Ventures, Tomorrow Ventures, Greylock Partners, Formation 8, Y Combinator, SV Angel, Lerer Ventures, HBS Angels, Sand Hill Angels to name a few.

Rubicon raises capital from corporates, individual high net worth investors, family offices and institutional LPs creating a powerful extensive global network. This provides our portfolio companies access to strategic relationships resulting in partnerships, talent, advisory boards, key customer introductions, leading venture capital firms for follow on funding and ultimately introductions and advice related to buyers for M&A or IPO.

We enable our LPs to co-invest along side the fund on a deal-by-deal basis via innovative sidecar funds right up to IPO or M&A exit. name: SOUKMEDIA
tagline: B2B Demand Intelligence | Powered by AudienceOS | ACE360° | UPCOMING-Global B2B Events Community|Tech Brands |US,SG,IND|
description:
Most B2B demand generation produces activity. Webinars that don't convert. Content that reaches the wrong people. Ads that land in front of the right company but the wrong person at the wrong moment.

SOUKMEDIA was built to solve a different problem — not how to produce more marketing activity, but how to build a demand system that knows your audience before you reach them, and compounds over time.

We are a B2B demand intelligence company working with enterprise tech companies and fast-growing global SaaS brands who are building pipeline for the 12-24 month horizon.

How we work:
AudienceOS — Our proprietary audience intelligence layer. Built from years of first-party B2B event data through our UPCOMING community, AudienceOS profiles your ideal buyers, identifies intent signals and tells us where they are in the decision cycle before we build a single piece of content or run a single ad.
ACE360° — Our demand-gen architecture system. Ads, Content and Events working as one system — not three separate services. Every event generates audience intelligence that informs the content strategy. Every content piece nurtures the event audience. Every ad reaches people AudienceOS has already identified as ready. 
The result: pipeline that compounds, not campaigns that expire.
UPCOMING — Our B2B events community. Your audience already lives here. We bring them to your stage.
We work on retainer with brands building for the long game — not project-by-project with brands chasing the next quarter.
Founded in 2018, offices in USA, Singapore and India, operating in the world.

name: Finspectors.ai
tagline: AI Native Workspace for Audit Firms
description:
Finspectors is an AI-native audit workspace that enables audit firms to run the entire audit process within a single structured platform. It combines transaction analysis, document intelligence, workflow management, standardized testing, and quality management controls to replace spreadsheet-driven audit reviews.

Audit teams can upload accounting exports such as general ledgers, vouchers, journal entries, and trial balances. Finspectors analyses the full transaction population using machine learning, rule-based testing, statistical techniques, and narration analysis to identify higher-risk entries, with clear explanations for audit teams and reviewers.

The platform also manages the operational side of audits. Teams can issue and track client document requests, extract data from evidence using AI, and match transactions to supporting documents. Built-in sampling tools, financial statement validation, and automated workpaper generation help standardize testing and documentation across engagements.

Finspectors also includes a dedicated quality management and compliance layer designed to support modern audit standards. The platform helps firms implement structured audit workflows, maintain consistent documentation practices, and strengthen internal quality controls aligned with emerging regulatory expectations such as QC 1000, ISQM and other audit quality frameworks.

In addition, AI agents assist auditors with planning, evidence review, and audit documentation, helping teams complete engagements more efficiently while maintaining consistent audit quality.

name: Idea Grove
tagline: B2B visibility built for the AI search era. PR, SEO, content, and AI strategy — aligned.
description:
There's a meeting that happens at some version of nearly every B2B company, usually once a quarter. The marketing team reviews results. PR reports solid placements. SEO shows ranking improvements. Content shows healthy traffic. Then someone asks the question nobody wants to answer: "So why aren't we seeing more pipeline from all of this?"

The problem isn't effort. It's that visibility programs built in silos produce results that fade instead of compound. PR earns coverage that doesn't strengthen search. SEO optimizes pages that don't get amplified. Content gets published without a strategy connecting it to either. Each channel looks fine in its own report. But there's no system pulling it together — and in an era where AI platforms like ChatGPT and Gemini are reshaping how buyers find and evaluate vendors, scattered signals don't build authority. They get ignored.

Idea Grove was built to solve this. Our Total Visibility System aligns earned media, SEO, content, and AI optimization into a single coordinated engine — where every placement, every article, and every search signal reinforces the others. Authority accumulates. Discoverability grows. And visibility becomes something that compounds over time rather than restarting with every new campaign.

Gartner predicts earned media budgets will double by 2027 as AI-driven search becomes the dominant way buyers find vendors. We've been building toward this moment for years.

We work with midmarket B2B companies in SaaS, IT services, manufacturing, HVAC, logistics, data centers, and telecom. We're a three-time Inc. 5000 company, a two-time Inc. Best Workplace, and an O'Dwyer's Top 25 Tech Agency — with 20+ years of proven results and client experience that includes Amazon, NTT, Motorola Solutions, Sabre, and more.

If your visibility programs are generating activity without building authority, we should talk.

Here’s why:

Third-party sales training is generic and its effects are short-lived. 

Sales technology is bought and implemented as point solutions. 

Very few Sales Enablement professionals have led Enterprise SaaS sales organizations.

This why we started Playboox.

Like our name implies, we take a playbook-centric approach.

You likely have a playbook document.

We have a playbook system.

We help B2B SaaS providers with complex sales “playbook” deal-winning practices and make them actionable within Salesforce so sales and customer success managers can excel at deal coaching, and reps can perform optimally at each stage of the customer lifecycle.

Every program includes a dedicated team of Enterprise SaaS Enablement experts hailing from Enterprise SaaS stalwarts like Workday, Palo Alto Networks, ServiceNow, VMware/Carbon Black, SAP/Concur, Juniper Networks, Cloudera, and consultancies like Gartner and Accenture, among others.

Combining their expertise with Playboox’s technology, Enterprise SaaS Revenue Playbook content, and Deal Execution Excellence methodology will enable your frontline revenue leaders to drive team wide repeatable, sustainable and predictable revenue success.

Deals that are “playbooked” and coached by our experts have win rates that are 2-4x greater than those that don’t.

Our “Coach-the-Coach” program prepares and certifies frontline revenue leaders to leverage your playbooks and our deal coaching methodology and software.

name: Elevate Demand
tagline: The B2B agency for sustainable growth
description:
No more trying to scale mediocre marketing 

Most B2B marketing teams struggle to drive growth. They’re stuck trying to scale tactics. But more “growth experiments” is not what leads to sustainable growth. 

We’ve been there. Scaling tactics is a trap most of us fall into at some point in our marketing careers. That’s when we end up focusing on all the wrong problems and miss our targets.

You know how it goes - you start looking for better ads, different content, new headlines, updated positioning, revamped landing pages and constant A/B testing. And when that doesn’t work, you might go from lead generation to demand generation to account-based marketing and finally to brand marketing in an effort to drive demand. 

But unless your framework is built for sustainable growth, all these tactics and switch-ups will only lead you to a painfully obvious plateau. 

Most agencies and vendors only make it worse - they focus more on cookie-cutter strategies that are easy to scale than developing a unique growth formula for your business. The result is often inefficiencies that are nearly impossible to fix without a dip in short-term revenue. So you feel stuck. 

It’s time to adopt the Sustainable Growth Framework and build a brand deserving of growth. This is how you’ll capture, create and sustain demand.

name: Rebound
tagline: Marketing Acceleration
description:
Rebound is an outsourced B2B marketing partner for service providers to life sciences and healthcare, and for companies operating in other regulated markets.

We support small and growing companies, mid-market organizations, enterprise teams, and investors who need to accelerate go-to-market performance without the risk, cost, or rigidity of traditional hiring or agency models.

Rebound was purpose-built to deliver outsourced marketing as a modern operating model. We provide strategy-led, execution strong marketing through embedded teams that function as an extension of the business. Our teams can operate as a fully outsourced marketing function or in a hybrid model alongside existing marketing leaders and internal teams. This allows organizations to add capability, close gaps, and scale execution without disrupting what is already working.

Our clients include B2B SaaS, data, analytics, digital health, and professional services companies selling into life sciences, healthcare, and other regulated markets, where complexity, compliance, and long sales cycles demand discipline and precision.

Every engagement begins with our proprietary Marketing Acceleration™ Maturity Assessment, which creates clarity on what to build, what to defer, and where to focus for measurable progress.

Traditional agencies optimize for deliverables. Internal teams optimize for headcount. Rebound is built for outcomes.

Our model combines senior marketing leadership, including fractional CMOs, with experienced functional operators across positioning, brand, digital, content, marketing operations, and sales enablement. Teams scale up or down based on real business needs, not fixed scopes or long-term commitments. Our focus is on building durable go-to-market capability, not creating dependency.

Rebound is outsourced B2B marketing, designed for regulated markets and built to work standalone or alongside your team.

Beinsure.com is a global B2B digital media and market intelligence platform focused on insurance, reinsurance, InsurTech, cyber risk, AI, blockchain, SaaS technologies, and investment trends shaping the future of risk markets. The platform was founded by entrepreneur and angel investor Oleg Parashchak.

Since 2006, Beinsure has delivered insurance news, market research, rankings, expert analysis, funding insights, technology reviews, and data-driven intelligence for insurers, reinsurers, brokers, founders, investors, analysts, and decision-makers. The platform was relaunched in 2022 as a global insurance & InsurTech research hub.

Beinsure reaches 2.2M+ annual readers across key global insurance markets and is ranked among the leading insurance and InsurTech media platforms by audience, including insurance executives, reinsurers, brokers, InsurTech founders, investors, risk managers, compliance leaders, technology providers, cybersecurity professionals.

Beinsure covers insurance, reinsurance, InsurTech, AI in insurance, cyber insurance, risk management, blockchain, SaaS, underwriting technology, claims innovation, insurance analytics, market rankings, funding activity, M&A, regulation, and global risk trends.

Our mission is to make complex insurance and technology topics clear, practical, and useful. We focus on structured analysis, transparent data, trusted rankings, independent market insight, and professional content that helps readers understand how risk, capital, regulation, and technology are changing insurance markets.

Beinsure combines digital media, market analytics, audience intelligence, and data-driven research to support better decision-making across the insurance, reinsurance, InsurTech, and financial technology sectors.

Between 2022 and 2026, Beinsure raised $1M across Pre-Seed ($200K) and Seed ($800K) rounds led by Finance Media and reached an $11M valuation, with participation from angel investor Oleg Parashchak.

description:
Ignition is the leading venture capital firm focused on early-stage investments in enterprise software. 

Our mission is to be a transformative partner to our portfolio companies, investing not only our capital but our time, expertise and personal/professional relationships with top leaders in technology and throughout the Fortune 500.   We will do everything in our power to help our founders achieve their mission of building an iconic business. 

We know “early enterprise.” This understanding is not academic but comes from our team’s collective experience in leadership positions at top technology and Fortune 500 companies, as startup builders, and investors.  This is not just the space we invest in, but the life we live and the circles we move in. 

Our network is unparalleled.  We have deep relationships with well-respected entrepreneurs and key decision makers within top technology companies and members of the Fortune 500.   Through these relationships and our past experience as builders and operators, we understand the needs of your potential customers, partners, and acquirers.   

Through our focus on enterprise software, our duo-locations in Seattle and Silicon Valley, and our past experience, we have deep relationships with the cloud vendors. We don’t just know the “VC relationship” person at AWS, Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud, we also know the best Go-To-Market people (the engineering and product teams, the business development teams and field leaders)--and know them well.  Corporate development too!  Why does this matter?  More than any other investor, we can help you position your business and products to meet your business goals and provide you with access to influential decision-makers who can change the trajectory of your business. 

We have a track record of investing in category makers such as Cloudera, Docker, DocuSign, Heroku, Icertis, Splunk, XenSource and Xamarin. Ignition Partners has returned more than $1B to investors since 2012. 

We are actively investing in early-stage startups in the following sectors:   Cloud Computing, Intelligent apps, Cybersecurity, B2B, Business IT, Machine Learning, AI (Artificial Intelligence), Frontier Tech, SaaS, Vertical SaaS, Business Applications. 

Silicon Valley & Seattle

name: CallBlitz
tagline: The real-time call coaching platform that works with any dialer 📞
description:
Cold calling alone is brutal. Whether you're a solo rep with no one to learn from, or a sales leader watching your remote team lose the energy of the floor, the result is the same: bad habits, zero real-time feedback, and burnout.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
CallBlitz is the only virtual sales floor that works with any dialer. Our Chrome extension gives managers whisper coaching, stealth listen-in, and auto-muting during live calls, not after them. 

Solo reps get access to the same live coaching sessions, 100+ on-demand trainings, and a community of reps who cold call together daily.                                                                       
                  
Built around the Buckets framework by Ryan Reisert (author of "Outbound Sales, No Fluff"), CallBlitz is where reps come to get better at the phone, whether they have a team behind them or not.

Results: Teams see a 2-3X increase in total dials and conversations on CallBlitz vs Zoom blitzes. Solo reps go from calling in silence to calling alongside peers with live coaching from day one.

Ready to stop cold calling alone?

name: Lock Search Group
tagline: Our mission to partner great companies with exceptional talent.
description:
Lock Search Group is the leading independent search firm in Canada. Our mission is to provide exceptional Recruitment and Consulting services to clients and candidates. We apply our experience and expertise to deliver solutions with a personalized approach that focuses on client needs and candidate goals.

Our values and practices are based on developing lasting business relationships through open, honest communication. We pride ourselves on knowing our stuff, on being well-networked, and being professional, without being too serious. Fun in business is important. Being approachable, being part of the team, acting with integrity: all part of the Lock DNA since day one.

Lock Search Group was founded in 1983. We have grown to a network of 11 offices in Canada and two in the United States. With more than 25 Recruitment Consultants and Associates on staff, we take great pride in delivering a true national solution. Many of our clients have offices in the U.S., and many of our American clients have Canadian divisions. We provide a seamless service to all. 

We work with a diverse set of companies and fill a variety of sales, managerial, leadership, and/or executive roles. Our core practice areas are:
• Life Science (Biotechnology, Medical Device, Pharmaceutical, Scientific and Clinical Research, etc.)
• Consumer Packaged Goods (Beverage/Alcohol, Cannabis, Core, Food Service, Hard Goods, Retail, etc.)
• Industrial (Automation, Building Materials, Construction, Distribution, Houseware, Manufacturing, Metals and Mining, Tools, Supply Chain and Logistics, Operations, Engineering, etc.)
• B2B and Technology (Digital and Artificial Intelligence, Information Technology, SaaS, Security Equipment and Services, Telecommunications, Insurance, Accounting, Finance, Legal, Human Resources, etc.)

If you are looking to hire or looking for career opportunities, please do not hesitate to reach out to us!

name: Perceptis AI
tagline: Business-grade Slides. AI-powered. Data-backed. Executive-ready.
description:
At Perceptis, we harness the power of AI to enable massive productivity and growth for knowledge workers. We do so by automating and augmenting tedious corporate workflows: slide and document creation, information retrieval, and knowledge management.

In companies where growth requires creating professional proposals at high volume, significant time is spent searching through documents, and developing custom presentations. Perceptis streamlines this tedious work and helps accelerate your business.

With Slidekick, you can create professional slides in minutes through our self-serve platform. What once took days of work is now done in minutes.

With Chatalyst, you can unlock your company's knowledge instantly. Chat with your documents, get answers, and analyze your content in real-time.

For custom documents requiring additional anti-hallucination checks and quality oversight, our expert team delivers elite-grade professional documents of any type within 24 hours or less.

As a result of our AI-powered tools, our customers often produce more high-quality materials each month (2-3x), observe higher win rates (40-70% increase), and enjoy up to 100% revenue boost within weeks of starting using Perceptis.

Your data privacy is our top consideration. The documents that you share with Perceptis are only used to train your unique custom model. That custom model is placed on an isolated endpoint that serves only accounts from your organization, and it does not ”talk” to the rest of the world.

Try Slidekick for free: https://app.perceptis.ai/

Visit our website: https://perceptis.ai

TendersGo is a global tender, contract, and procurement search engine built to help businesses discover opportunities faster, smarter, and across borders. As a service of Global Tenders and Bids LLC, TendersGo provides access to tenders, RFPs, RFQs, ITBs, contract awards, and procurement notices from public and private sector sources worldwide.

Our platform is designed for suppliers, exporters, manufacturers, consultants, contractors, and business development teams that want to monitor opportunities across countries, industries, and institutions from a single interface.

TendersGo currently supports opportunities from 220+ countries and content in 145 languages, with a standardized English version that helps users search across multilingual sources more efficiently. The platform is updated hourly, includes a large global archive of tenders and contracts, and offers advanced search and filtering tools powered by AI, NLP, and structured classification systems.

Beyond search, TendersGo also offers solutions for organizations and companies that want to publish tenders, collect bids, promote their business profiles, and expand visibility through integrated modules such as the Organization Module, Company Module, B2B Marketplace, and AI Assistance.

With unlimited advanced search, targeted tracking, archive access, contract intelligence, and scheduled email alerts, TendersGo helps businesses save time, reduce manual research, and identify relevant procurement opportunities more effectively.

All Countries. All Languages. All Sources. One Search Engine.

name: Ribbiot
tagline: The purpose-built Physical Operations Platform connecting people, processes, and equipment.
description:
Ribbiot is a physical operations platform built for equipment-centric specialty trades, the businesses that orchestrate people and equipment to get critical work done in the field.

In these operations, decisions are made in silos without clear visibility. Assumptions and manual processes break constantly, driving overages in time, labor, and cost. Lost or missing paperwork causes delays and missed opportunities. Stringing together apps adds fatigue and breeds resistance to technology, which only deepens the problem. The gaps among sales, scheduling, field execution, and the office lead to scheduling conflicts, resource mismanagement, lost productivity, and thinning margins. Ribbiot calls this the fog of operations, and removing it is the platform's whole point.

Ribbiot connects people, processes, and equipment into a single operational system of record. Teams replace paper, spreadsheets, whiteboards, and disconnected tools with a single source of truth that keeps work moving. The platform builds operational readiness before work starts, keeps field execution visible during work, and delivers financial clarity at closeout.

As a B2B vertical SaaS platform, Ribbiot's mission is to simplify the complexities of physical operations to deliver visibility and foster sustainable growth.

name: Triparound
tagline: Smart guest concierge platform for modern hospitality
description:
Triparound is a B2B travel tech company (SaaS) designed to meet the needs of hospitality professionals worldwide. As a comprehensive guest experience platform, Triparound empowers hotels, resorts, and vacation rentals to streamline operations, enhance guest satisfaction, and drive ancillary revenue growth.

The Triparound platform centralizes all guest services, making them easily bookable online and improving operational efficiency. Key features include advanced booking execution and management, omni-channel cross-selling, and streamlined communication that replaces numerous emails and calls with automated solutions. The Itinerary Builder allows businesses to create bespoke travel plans in minutes, providing real-time control over all aspects of guest services.

Triparound also integrates seamlessly with leading Property Management Systems (PMS), ensuring guest information flows securely and automatically between systems. The performance monitoring tools deliver powerful insights, helping businesses uncover new revenue streams and translate data into successful strategies. Triparound's dual guest-facing capabilities, such as its 'Book Now' buttons and customizable Guest Web App, enhance the guest journey from pre-arrival planning to in-stay experiences, fostering repeat business and long-term loyalty.

With a growing international customer base, Triparound is redefining how hospitality businesses connect with their guests, making experiential travel more accessible, enjoyable, and profitable than ever before.

description:
Research operations shouldn't feel like this.

The missed timelines. The data quality surprises. The constant coordination across vendors, programmers, and platforms — all while your clients expect flawless execution. Most research firms just absorb that friction. We built a company to eliminate it.

OpinionRoute is a research operations partner for market research agencies. We combine proprietary technology with expert-led managed services — handling the hard operational work so your team can focus on what they're actually good at: serving clients and delivering insights.

We're not a panel company. We're not a SaaS tool you have to figure out on your own. We're the team behind your team - with the systems, technology, and expertise to run research operations at a level most MRAs can't staff in-house.

What we do: sample strategy and sourcing with an insider's edge on vendor quality, survey programming and hosting built for complex designs and better respondent experiences, data quality through the only holistic quality system purpose-built for how researchers actually work, and full research operations management from kickoff to clean data.

Powering all of it is The Navigator, our survey operations platform, with CleanID and ResponseID adding fraud prevention and in-survey behavioral screening at every stage of data collection.

This is what "Work Better." means in practice.

What sets us apart:
• Premium product curation with real brand equity
• Print-accurate decoration and proofing
• Custom packaging and kit architecture
• Portal builds, recipient choice, and address capture through Moment
• Hands-on producers and timeline management

The outcome is consistent. Gifts people keep. Stories they share. Brands they remember.

Explore kits, packaging, and the Moment platform at cloveandtwine.com

description:
Argentum is a New York-based growth equity firm that has helped scale bootstrapped and founder-led B2B software, technology-enabled and business services companies for over 35 years. The firm invests in businesses that are generating $5M to $50M in annual revenues, providing capital to accelerate growth, fund acquisitions, and generate shareholder liquidity, without requiring owners to give up control or operational autonomy.  Argentum has invested in over 100 platform companies, supported more than 200 add-on acquisitions, been named to Inc.’s list Founder-Friendly Investors list for multiple years, and received the U.S. SBA’s SBIC of the Year award.  Argentum fills the growing gap between early-stage venture capital investors and later stage growth equity firms by targeting capital-efficient companies seeking $5M to $20M of equity capital.

- Industries: Business services, tech-enabled services, B2B software
- Company Size: Revenues of $5M to $50M
- Transaction Types: Growth equity, recaps
- Investment Size: $5M to $20M for minority ownership stakes (we can accommodate larger investments or control deals when appropriate or needed)
- Geography: U.S. based
- Business characteristics: Attractive growth profile & strategy, strong committed leadership, recurring revenue stream, proven & scalable business model, operating in highly fragmented industry, meaningful barriers of entry & competitive advantage

Please contact Chris Leong (chris@argentumgroup.com) with any prospective investment opportunities or portfolio company add-on acquisitions

name: Vocadian
tagline: Voice Intelligence Boosting Workforce Safety and Performance, starting with Fatigue
description:
Vocadian revolutionizes workforce safety, wellness, and productivity with its voice AI-powered B2B SaaS platform, seamlessly embedded into day-to-day workflows. Through quick pre-shift speech tasks—without extra hardware—it enables predictive fatigue assessment and performance forecasting. Unlike reactive alternatives, Vocadian proactively mitigates risks before incidents occur. With an initial focus on fatigue, Vocadian will incorporate alcohol and substance detection, as well as occupational disease prediction, to create a comprehensive ecosystem for employee safety and well-being. 

Targeting safety-critical industries such as transportation and logistics, mining, construction, manufacturing, aviation, and insurance, Vocadian serves LATAM and the US, with plans for global expansion. By mitigating risks, safeguarding workers, and fostering trust and well-being, Vocadian is set to redefine occupational safety and health standards worldwide.

As a Harvard-MIT-founded health tech venture, Vocadian believes that voice biomarkers, multimodal AI, and circadian science will lead a paradigm shift in improving organizational health, workforce safety, and productivity. Our vision is to build Multimodal Biosignal AI for Human Performance and Health.

We have been awarded by MIT $100K Entrepreneurship Competition, Harvard President’s Innovation Challenge, SXSW, Summerfest Tech Conference, Startup World Cup, HBS/Boston Shark Tank, HBS New Venture Competition, Allston Venture Fund, Contour Ventures, SBXi Fund, the MBA Fund pitch competition, Harvard HealthLab Accelerator, MIT Sloan Healthcare Innovation Prize, Supermoon Capital, NfX, and many more to come.

Our team values integrity, curiosity, and collaboration. We embrace ambiguity and address critical challenges that fundamentally impact society and human life. We build products that cultivate empathy, trust, and care.

description:
Syd Life AI is an award winning and clinically validated Life Quality & Preventive Health Technology powered by proprietary AI Models including a 70B-parameter LLM, 1.2M scientific research papers, 8.3B person-years of health data, 6+ years of R&D, and the Life Quality Index™ - measuring 9 interdependent dimensions across 750 KPIs, recognised by the World IP Organization and Cornell University as the Gold Standard for measuring and improving life quality.

We deliver predictive, actionable, and evidence-based data solutions that empower governments, insurers, corporations, educators, healthcare providers, and pharma - together with their citizens, members, employees, and patients - to improve life quality and reduce preventable health risks at scale.

We bring these insights to life through an AI-powered Super-App and AI mentor for individuals, providing 24/7 personalised, Life Quality & preventive health support grounded in principles of CBT; a real-time population analytics dashboard for organizations, delivering predictive insights on life quality, preventable conditions, costs, and ROI; and industry-specific AI integrations via API, enabling precision-driven strategies and advanced predictive modelling.  

Clinically validated in a randomised controlled trial with the UK’s National Health Service involving 10,000 RCT members, Syd Life AI demonstrated a 12-16% reduction in clinical levels of stress, anxiety, and depression - five times the impact of traditional therapy. With a proven 12-25x ROI, up to 40% reduction in NCD condition risk (including stress, anxiety, and depression), and 98% of members experiencing improvements in life quality, Syd Life AI is redefining preventive health and human-centric industries worldwide.

description:
Zumo believes everyone should have access to sustainable finance, and that blockchain has the power to deliver this globally. Its mission is to provide a better planet for digital assets, delivering sustainable, accessible and secure ways to unlock the benefits of web3. 

As an enterprise-focused digital-asset-as-a-service platform, Zumo’s turnkey, API-based infrastructure offers a fast, flexible and compliance-sensitive route to market, empowering fintechs, banks, asset managers and brands to offer their clients the tools of the future simply, securely and sustainably while also opening up new revenue streams, attracting new customers and supporting customer retention.

A values-driven business, Zumo has underlined its commitment to a fairer society and a sustainable planet with an ambitious 2030 net zero strategy encompassing its own business; the blockchains it works with; and the wider digital asset ecosystem. Carbon-neutral since inception, the business is committed to ongoing collaboration in the decarbonisation of the digital assets industry. Zumo was an early signatory of the Crypto Climate Accord, the first digital asset business to receive UK government funding from the UK’s national innovation agency, Innovate UK, to further its applied work on the decarbonisation of digital assets, and is now a key contributor to industry guidance on the energy consumption of blockchain, working in tandem with  the World Economic Forum and the OECD.

Zumo’s infrastructure also powers the direct-to-consumer Zumo App, launched in the UK and registered with the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA).

name: Gather Voices
tagline: Video is too important to be hard. Gather Voices makes video simple.
description:
Gather Voices helps organizations access and share the authentic stories of stakeholders to create more impact. 

OUR MISSION
We enable organizations to collect and share user-generated video from stakeholders by tapping into the powerful cameras that everyone has in their phones, tablets and laptops. Our technology coaches end users to make better video, and we build tools to enable organizations to quickly realize value from this content. User-generated video for organizations was always great in theory but nearly impossible in practice. Our mission is to make it easy for everyone. 

OUR VISION
The best marketing comes from happy customers talking about their experiences. The best training comes from those that already do the job sharing their methods. The best fundraising comes from donors sharing how they made a difference. The best member engagement comes from sharing the voices of engaged members. We’re working toward a world when raising these authentic voices will be easy and becomes the obvious best practice and first place to start for digital engagement practitioners.

name: Cavintek
tagline: Automate. Make everyday productive.
description:
Cavintek develops cloud-based (SaaS) business process automation software for small and medium enterprises. Cflow is a cloud-based BPM and workflow software that provides a simple way to automate business processes within companies. Cflow helps SMBs transition from running their operations on email and spreadsheets to using business applications that help increase productivity and reduce costs. Cflow reins in the complexity of data and process management that can quickly grow to exponential proportions and overwhelm SMBs.

Create approval-based workflows in minutes and hours, instead of weeks and months. No coding is necessary and workflows can be created, tested and published immediately. Use cases include Capex Approvals, Travel Requests, Expense Reimbursements, Procurement, Invoicing and Purchase Order processes. Cflow also includes a business activity monitor to identify bottlenecks both at a process level and user level. A dynamic report builder helps users gain critical business insights for effective management of their workflows.

Organizations have reported 70% to 200% improvement in average cycle time and overall throughput. Customers include Del Monte, NutriAsia, Toll Group, Standard Bank (Africa Region), Raj Petro Specialties, and more, spanning industries like Food Processing, Warehousing and Logistics, Banking, Energy, and Education.

Tomorrow’s success is not accidental. It is engineered today.

description:
Hunters and Unicorns is a leading executive recruitment firm specialising in high-growth SaaS sales companies servicing the Americas and EMEA markets.

We bring A-player candidates to the most ambitious tech companies on the planet and transform their revenue performance.

With our extensive industry knowledge and unique playbook, we have successfully placed hundreds of top-tier executives in some of the world's most successful organizations, including MongoDB, Zscaler and Snowflake.

Our highly acclaimed podcast series has garnered over 1 million downloads globally across various episodes. It showcases industry thought leaders, successful entrepreneurs, executives and exceptional practitioners to share their insights, strategies, and experiences in the world of B2B SaaS sales.

 Hunters and Unicorns also provides fractional advisory services through VC’s to enhance the potential of an exit event.
 
Get in touch if you:
-	Are seeking A-player candidates within GTM to help you meet revenue milestones.
-	Would like to nominate yourself or someone to be featured on our show.
-	Are Interested in opportunities within the playbook community.
-	Want to access our elite community of advisors to help you transform revenue performance.

name: New Converts
tagline: Fix your offer. Fill your pipeline.
description:
Most B2B companies don’t struggle with lead generation first.

They struggle with how their offer shows up in the market.

If prospects can’t clearly see why you’re different, they compare you on price. That leads to weaker margins, longer sales cycles, and a pipeline full of conversations that don’t move.

We help B2B companies selling $20k+ deals fix their offer, sharpen their positioning, and build outbound systems that turn demand signals into qualified sales calls.

Before we send a single email, we work on the message:
what makes the offer different, what the ICP actually cares about, and why buyers should take the conversation now.

Then we build and run the outbound system:
dedicated domains, warmed inboxes, verified contacts, demand-signal targeting, multi-touch campaigns, reply qualification, and calendar booking.

The goal is simple:

15-25 qualified sales calls with verified decision-makers in your ICP within 90 days.

If we don’t hit the agreed threshold, you pay nothing.

We’ve used this system for 20+ B2B companies across SaaS, manufacturing, and professional services.
